coordinator_release_gate.mechanism: Explicit coordinator release switch (--coordinator-release / --allow-model-execution) integrated into teacher-benchmark and teacher-da3 CLIs, command dispatch, and execute_guarded_da3_benchmark. Fails closed (exit 1 / BenchmarkRefusalError) before touching RunStore by default; when explicitly authorized by coordinator, routes to real_pipeline under parent supervision without hardcoded refusal.

supervision.mechanism: Child process group via subprocess.Popen(start_new_session=True), continuous parent supervision loop monitoring timeout, RSS, swap, grandchildren, os.killpg termination, and POSIX empty group proof.

pre_reservation_rejection.mechanism: Approval, statistical protocol JSON, weights manifest, views quota, cumulative budget, and coordinator release prerequisite checked BEFORE touching RunStore.

readonly_inspect.mechanism: Direct SQLite URI mode=ro query avoiding RunStore initialization, DDL execution, or table metadata mutations.

ledger_query_and_fail_closed.mechanism: Corrected column to active_seconds; damaged/abnormal ledgers fail closed with BenchmarkRefusalError instead of returning 0.0.

cumulative_views_accounting.mechanism: Enforced lifetime 64-view cumulative quota across all derived jobs in RunStore; double-checked both before and inside worker_lock.

mutation_controls.name: Control 1: Wall Clock Timeout Supervision Gate
mutation_controls.baseline: Normal execution within budget -> returncode=0, violation=None
mutation_controls.mutated: Runaway worker (sleep > budget) -> killed by supervisor, violation=timeout, empty_group_proven=True

mutation_controls.name: Control 2: Process Group RSS Protection Gate
mutation_controls.baseline: Normal memory allocation (5 MiB <= 150 MiB) -> returncode=0
mutation_controls.mutated: Runaway memory (200 MiB > 80 MiB limit) -> killed by supervisor, violation=rss_limit, empty_group_proven=True

mutation_controls.name: Control 3: Orphan Grandchild Leak Detection Gate
mutation_controls.mutated: Group leader exits early leaving background grandchild -> killed by supervisor, violation=grandchild_leak, empty_group_proven=True

mutation_controls.name: Control 4: Corrupt Ledger Fail-Closed Protection Gate
mutation_controls.baseline: Valid SQLite ledger -> read-only inspect computes accurate active_seconds and cumulative_views
mutation_controls.mutated: Corrupted or non-SQLite file -> fails closed raising BenchmarkRefusalError, strictly no fallback to 0.0
